printPage.title: Print documents
printPage.intro: Home payments and individual payment slips for the selected month.
printPage.pdfHint: Choose Save as PDF or a printer in the print dialog. Use A4, 100% scale, 5 mm margins and disable browser headers and footers. Documents include all assessed fees for the month, including paid fees.
printPage.error: Unable to prepare the document. Please retry.

financeOverview.title: Financial overview
financeOverview.intro: All building funds in one place
financeOverview.loadError: Unable to load finances. Check your access and try again.
financeOverview.scope: Overview of all recorded movements, including money held in archived funds and repairs.
financeOverview.monthlyHint: Includes all generated accounting months. Difference = income − funds − expenses; balance = difference + carryover.
financeOverview.recentHint: Latest 50 movements by payment/recording date. Filters apply to this list. Fund fees are included only once.

cashierFinance.readyToClose: All fees and bills are paid. This month can be closed.
cashierFinance.closeRequirements: Pay all home fees and bills before closing the month.
cashierFinance.closeExplanation: Closing prevents new payments, income and expenses for this month. Payments in earlier months will continue to update the carried balance and total.
cashierFinance.notSettled: There are unpaid fees or bills. Refresh and settle them before closing.
cashierFinance.closeError: Closing could not be confirmed. You can retry.
cashierFinance.balanceFormula:
Monthly difference = income − fund allocations − expenses and bills.
Total = monthly difference + previous balance.
cashierFinance.name: Description
cashierFinance.noBills: No bills configured. Add them in building management.
cashierFinance.noIncomes: No single incomes for this month.
cashierFinance.incomeHelp: Record money received outside home fees. It will be included in the selected month.
cashierFinance.paymentHelp: Record an actual payment. The amount will be included in the selected month.
cashierFinance.loadError: Financial data could not be loaded.
cashierFinance.invalidEntry: Check the amount and document details.
cashierFinance.entryUnavailable: You cannot access this entry or it is no longer available. Refresh the data.
cashierFinance.saveUnconfirmed: The save could not be confirmed. Retry the same request; the amount will not be counted twice.
cashierFinance.accountingMonthCompleted: This month is closed. New entries cannot be added.
cashierFinance.cashierBillAlreadyPaid: This bill is already paid for the selected month.
cashierFinance.cashierRequestChanged: This request was already used with different details. Refresh and open a new entry.
cashierFinance.cashierAmountLimit: This amount exceeds the supported monthly total.

cashierAccounting.paymentHint: Choose Pay to review and pay all fees due for a home. Select a payment date to see its breakdown.
cashierAccounting.title: Monthly accounting
cashierAccounting.noHomes: There are no homes in this condominium.
cashierAccounting.noMonths: No accounting months have been created. Contact your property manager.
cashierAccounting.currentMonthMissing: The current accounting month has not been created. Contact your property manager.
cashierAccounting.closed: This month is closed. Payments can only be viewed.
cashierAccounting.loadError: The data could not be loaded.
cashierAccounting.paymentError: Payment could not be confirmed. Refresh the data before trying again.
cashierAccounting.homeFeesChanged: The fees have changed. Refresh the data and review the new amount.
cashierAccounting.homeFeesAlreadyPaid: There are no unpaid fees. Refresh the data to view the payment.
cashierAccounting.accountingMonthCompleted: This month has already been closed.
cashierAccounting.feeNotAssignedToFund: A fund fee has no assigned fund. Contact your property manager.

cashierPage.chooseBuilding: Choose a condominium to view accounting months and record payments.
cashierPage.editAssignmentHint: Select condominiums to assign and clear the selection to unassign. You can unassign all condominiums.
cashierPage.assignmentSaveError: Changes could not be saved. Please try again.
cashierPage.limit: The cashier limit has been reached.
cashierPage.saveError: Unable to register the cashier. Check the details and try again.
cashierPage.limitOrEmail: The cashier limit has been reached or this email is already registered. Refresh the list and check the email.
cashierPage.managerDescription: Register cashiers and assign the condominiums they manage.
cashierPage.cashierDescription: Your condominiums and access to their funds and repairs.
cashierPage.emptyHint: Use the registration button to add your first cashier.
cashierPage.assignmentHint: Select the condominiums this cashier will be able to access.
cashierPage.noAvailableCondominiums: You have no condominiums to assign yet. You can register a cashier without any condominiums.
